Home.headline: Full-stack/AI Engineer & Content Creator
Home.title: Hi,
Home.bio: I help businesses turn ideas into real, working products. I build <hl>full-stack applications</hl> and practical AI solutions — not just chatbots, but AI that can work with business data, automate workflows, and solve real problems. I <hl>care about the details</hl> that make a product feel solid.

About.title: About
About.intro: I am a Full-stack/AI Engineer focused on craft, clarity, and products that feel intentional.
About.profileBody: Based in Ho Chi Minh City, I design and build modern web interfaces with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I care about performance, accessibility, and thoughtful motion.
highlights: Strong focus on design systems and reusable UI
Comfortable collaborating across product, design, and backend
Regularly share learnings through content and mentoring
